item.title: SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Rumor Reveals The Next Trilogy's Overarching Big Bad
item.description: A new Spider-Man: Brand New Day rumour claims to reveal which classic villain will be the overarching threat of this new trilogy, but what does that mean for Daredevil: Born Again?

item.title: SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Rumored To Make A Big, Potentially Divisive, Change To Punisher's Skull Logo
item.description: According to a new rumour, Marvel Studios has made a big change to The Punisher's skull logo in Spider-Man: Brand New Day, and it's already dividing opinions on social media.

item.title: MAN OF TOMORROW: James Gunn Teases Lex Luthor's Team Up With Superman While Marking Villain's Anniversary
item.description: James Gunn has celebrated the anniversary of Lex Luthor's creation with a new social media post that teases the villain's team up with Superman in next summer's Man of Tomorrow.

item.title: Horror Roundup: SCREAM 7 Final Trailer; WEDNESDAY Adds Winona Ryder; READY OR NOT 2 Extended Preview
item.description: Scream 7 has dropped a final trailer, Wednesday Season 3 just made several key casting additions as production begins, and Ready or Not 2: Here I Come gets an extended sneak peek.

item.title: MAN OF TOMORROW Director James Gunn Reveals Which Brainiac Story He DIDN'T Take Inspiration From
item.description: James Gunn has revealed which Superman story involving the villainous Brainiac he did not take inspiration from while working on the script for Man of Tomorrow...

item.title: 28 YEARS LATER: Danny Boyle's Threequel May Have Been Shelved Due To Poor Box Office Performance
item.description: Like 28 Years Later, The Bone Temple underperformed at the box office. Now, a new report claims that Sony has decided against moving forward with the planned third chapter starring Cillian Murphy.

item.title: BLACK PANTHER Director Ryan Coogler's Reboot Of THE X-FILES Greenlit As Danielle Deadwyler Boards Cast
item.description: The X-Files reboot is officially moving forward at Hulu, with Black Panther director Ryan Coogler set to write and direct a pilot, which will star Danielle Deadwyler as co-lead.

item.title: BAFTA Issues Apology To SINNERS Stars Michael B. Jordan & Delroy Lindo After N-Word Outburst
item.description: Tourette’s campaigner John Davidson shouted a racial slur at Sinners stars Michael B. Jordan and Delroy Lindo last night, and BAFTA has now issued an apology...
